title: Categorical constancy of complete Segal spaces and rowwise weak equivalences
statement:
Use the simplicial spaces, vertical Reedy fibrancy, complete Segal spaces and Rezk weak equivalences of [lem-coef-rezk-local-model], and categorical equivalences of simplicial sets in the Joyal model structure of [lem-coef-joyal-model-structure]. For a bisimplicial set $X$ call $X_{\bullet,q}$ its row of vertical degree $q$. If $X$ is a vertically Reedy fibrant complete Segal space, then every row $X_{\bullet,q}$ is a quasicategory and, for each $q\geq0$, the map
$$X_{\bullet,0}\longrightarrow X_{\bullet,q}$$
induced contravariantly by the unique map $[q]\to[0]$ in the vertical simplex variable is a categorical equivalence. For any map $f:X\to Y$ of bisimplicial sets, if $f_{\bullet,q}$ is a categorical equivalence for every $q\geq0$, then $f$ is a Rezk weak equivalence. The last assertion does not require $X$ or $Y$ to be fibrant.
